notes.title: Patch 2.0.5 is oUt !
notes.notes:
Small but important fixes thanks to the community reports! Keep them coming, we'll never stop to fix!
- Fixed recolored animations not appearing after Steam Deck Update
- Fixed characters remaining colored after being hit by certain endgame attacks
- Fixed crash when closing the game
- Fixed crash when stopping a looped BGS
- Fixed purple door fight

notes.title: Minor bugfix
notes.notes:
-Fixed a crash on Chinese systems due to error in .Net framework.
-Fixed a crash when minimizing the game by clicking on the windows application bar.
